rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE: approved provider programs, single programs approved by the board, academic courses (15 h per credit hour), seminars/workshops, home study with posttest (without posttest max 10); limited credit for cross-disciplinary, self-directed, practicum supervision, teaching, publications, professional organizations
rules.audit_note: CE reporting form submitted at renewal with evidence of ethics (and mental-disorder hours for LMSW/LSCSW); board may request records before renewal.
rules.notes: LMSW and LSCSW: at least 6 of the 40 units on diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders (no topic code). 1 unit = 50 min classroom. First aid/CPR/agency in-service not accepted. Board site ksbsrb.ks.gov returned 403 to our checker; cycle dates, fees and audit details not confirmed.
